'''Sulfurous Quartz Deposit''' is the renamed redstone ore.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
As vanilla redstone ore; the deepslate variant is the [[Sulfur Deposit|sulfur deposit]].

=== Breaking ===
Mined with a pickaxe (see [[Tools#Mining levels]]), it drops 1 [[Sulfur Chunk|sulfur chunk]] and 2–3 quartz. Silk Touch drops the block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/redstone_ore.json}}</ref>
